task_description: Build a playable browser-based single-player 3D zombie-apocalypse game with three.js (vendored offline). Protagonist wakes in a room in Odisha, fights zombies with a knife then a gun, meets survivor NPCs, gets a cure quest from a research center, collects ingredients, travels to a medical facility, delivers the cure, and reaches a helicopter finale. Modular zone system, friendly+hostile+killable NPCs, HUD, win/lose. Single-player (not a true MMORPG) and one starting city + one travel zone, per the offline/static-site constraints. Runs via python3 -m http.server; all assets procedurally generated.

verification.summary: No build step (static site); NODE_OPTIONS= node --check passes on all 14 JS modules. No unit-test framework by design; verification is a headless agent-browser harness driving real code paths. Full player-path story loop verified: start in OdishaCity/OBJ_WAKE -> leave room (real doorway-cross event) advances to OBJ_SURVIVE -> knife+gun combat -> collect 3 ingredients -> travel to MedicalFacility/OBJ_DELIVER -> WIN; triggerLose -> LOSE. window.__consoleErrors empty throughout. Test hooks drive the same real events a player triggers (no shortcut). Docker not applicable (no Dockerfile; static site).

review.v1: NEEDS_CHANGES - blocking OBJ_WAKE soft-lock + 4 secondary issues (test hooks masking, zone GPU disposal, requiredIngredients undefined, over-broad error filter)
review.v2: APPROVED - all 5 issues resolved and independently verified
